svg.title: V8 · A complete reservation intent
svg.desc: Incomplete property: post.stock = pre.stock − quantity is insufficient by itself. This is a handler example, not the approve recipe. Counterexample · quantity zero: Stock can remain unchanged and the equation still holds. A promised reservation might also be absent. Corrected obligations: Require positive quantity, exact stock relation, nonnegative stock, reservation existence and the correct entity identities. Scope of the evidence: Model bounds and assumptions are explicit. Actual native refinement and implementation mutants are separate witnesses; none proves every deployment.

g.text: Business promise failed: no positive request and no reservation.
Correct the intent, not just the arithmetic
quantity > 0; correct reservation exists; exact stock relation;
stock ≥ 0. The zero-quantity case now refuses.
Bounded model example; native implementation evidence is separate.
